Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target name. Join compound_records to activities and docs to compound_records to capture publication provenance. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
